d: Maggie sees Joel in a new light when he donates inherited land to the Indians, then learns of his ulterior motive.

st: Dreams and Schemes and Putting Greens
d: Holling leaves an expectant Shelly waiting at the altar; Joel convinces some Japanese investors to buy his way out of Cicely.
A flu epidemic in Cicely spoils Joel's romantic reunion with his visiting fiancée, Elaine, who is befriended by Maggie.
A shocked Holling learns that Shelly is married when her husband arrives in Cicely to ask for a divorce; Ed attempts to write a blockbuster movie.
When Maurice realizes he has no heir, he asks Chris to become his son; Maggie helps Joel teach childbirth classes.

st: The Aurora Borealis: A Fairy Tale for Big People
d: Joel claims to have been rescued by a legendary Bigfoot-like creature; Chris becomes friends with an artist who turns out to be his brother.
The Cicely townspeople rally to help Joel cope when they learn that his New York fiancée has left him for an older man.
An Indian spirit (Floyd Red Crow Westerman) advises Ed on finding his parents and Chris on regaining his voice.
Maggie purports Joel to be her boyfriend to gain her father's approval; Holling comes to a very personal decision.
Joel reconsiders a visit to New York when his temporary replacement charms the townspeople and Maggie dreams his plane crashes.
Spring: Holling picks fights with patrons; Ed seeks a once-a-year kleptomaniac; Maurice falls for a trooper.
Everyone except Maurice welcomes a vacationing Russian (Elya Baskin); Holling has nightmares; Ed falls in love.
Rick's death by falling satellite further enhances Maggie's reputation; Maurice meets prospective hoteliers.
Joel's wheeler-dealer twin (Rob Morrow in a dual role) pretends to be Joel; Chris' radio confession generates guilt.
Adam the hermit's hypochondriac wife holds Joel hostage; Maggie goes on a drinking binge after learning her deceased boyfriend Rick was unfaithful.
Joel searches for the chemical that makes Chris irresistible to women; Maggie learns she needs glasses; Chris experiences unrequited love.
Plane engine trouble strands Maggie and Joel in the wilderness; an old friend says she will marry Shelly's ex-husband.
Maggie thinks a stray dog is Rick reincarnated; Maurice and Marilyn go into business producing ostrich eggs; Ed's movie premieres.
The well-preserved 200-year-old body of a Frenchman washes up on the shores of Cicely with a journal that could change history.
